# PixelRoast

> Emotional Damage on Demand - AI-Powered Design Critique Tool

## Overview
PixelRoast is a brutal, AI-powered design critique tool that roasts websites and resumes with personality-driven feedback. Users submit portfolio URLs or resumes, and an AI "Senior Art Director" persona analyzes them using computer vision and LLMs. Feedback is delivered as a "Roast" - harsh, funny, but ultimately actionable advice.

## Features
- **Website Screenshot Analysis**: Captures full-page screenshots and analyzes UI/UX with AI vision models
- **Three Personality Modes**: Gen Z Intern (slang-heavy), Boomer Boss (corporate jargon), Gordon Ramsay (pure rage)
- **Tailwind CSS Fixes**: Every error comes with copy-paste Tailwind classes to fix the issue
- **Interactive "Clapback Engine"**: Chat with the AI to argue, clarify, or get roasted further
- **Resume Analysis**: PDF upload with PII redaction for resume reality checks

## Tech Stack
- **Frontend**: React 18 + Vite + Tailwind CSS (Neo-Brutalist Design)
- **Backend**: FastAPI + Playwright (Chromium) + Groq AI
- **Database**: Supabase (Auth + PostgreSQL)
- **Cache/Rate Limiting**: Upstash Redis
- **Hosting**: Cloudflare Pages (Frontend) + Hugging Face Spaces (Backend)

## AI Models Used
- **Vision (Free)**: meta-llama/llama-4-scout-17b-16e-instruct
- **Vision (Premium)**: meta-llama/llama-4-maverick-17b-128e-instruct
- **Chat**: llama-3.1-8b-instant (all tiers)
- **Resume**: llama-3.3-70b-versatile (Free), moonshotai/kimi-k2-instruct (Premium)

## API Endpoints
- `POST /roast` - Analyze website design with AI vision
- `POST /chat` - Interactive chat with roast context
- `POST /scans` - Save roast to user history
- `GET /scans` - Retrieve user's roast history
- `DELETE /scans/{id}` - Delete a saved roast
- `GET /health` - API health check

## Rate Limits
- **Free Tier**: 20 website roasts (lifetime), 1 request/60 seconds
- **Premium Tier**: 50 roasts/day, no rate limit on requests
- **Chat**: 10 messages/60 seconds (all tiers)
